incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — high tail latency observed for customer Helix (prod) 
incident-bot: Affected route: /v1/chat/stream (model: gptx-redwood-13b-fp16). p95 = 420ms -> 1.2s, p99 = 1.8s -> 6.4s over last 12m. Paging oncall maria-oncall.
maria-oncall: I'm on it, looking at the console now. Can someone post the scatter of tail latencies by node? :eyes:
kevin-eng: pulling traces. Looks like streaming stalls correlate with long multi-line code-block prompts from Helix (they send large JSON + code). KV cache miss rate spikes at the same time.
sre-alex: I see spikes on these hosts: gpu-rw-22, gpu-rw-23. CPU on worker 23 is fine but GPU utilization drops then surges -> possible kernel stall. Logs show repeated tokenization timeouts:
```
[2026-03-15T15:02:12Z] helix-prod-req-xxxx parsed_prompt_len=23k tok_time=1.8s kvcache_pop_failure=true stream_write_delay=520ms
[2026-03-15T15:02:13Z] helix-prod-req-xxxx model_infer_step=1 token_gen=300ms model_blocked=true
```
maria-oncall: Noting customer impact: Helix has 12% error-rate increase and elevated p99 for 15m. Paging their support contact. helix-support-bot, can you confirm if they're seeing retries?
helix-support-bot: Helix reports multiple retries from their side, some user-facing timeouts at 3s. They've temporarily disabled streaming client-side timeouts to reduce errors.
kevin-eng: Hypothesis: unusual prompt shapes (huge code fences + repeated delimiters) make tokenizer produce huge token spikes and scatter cache locality, leading to KV cache thrash and occasional lock contention in the runtime.
maria-oncall: Quick mitigations we can try: 1) Route Helix traffic to smaller sequence-optimized variant (gptx-redwood-13b-short-seq) 2) Enable prefix/KV cache sticky routing for their tenant 3) Scale up dedicated pool for 5-10m. Which is fastest?
sre-alex: Fastest is routing them to fallback model variant. I can flip routing policy for the tenant and scale up the pool in parallel. Doing it now.
sre-alex: Running: `redwoodctl routes update --tenant helix --route /v1/chat/stream --fallback gptx-redwood-13b-short-seq --reason "tail latency mitigation"`
sre-alex: Also `kubectl scale deployment/rw-dedicated-helix --replicas=6 -n inference-prod` (from 4 -> 6).
kevin-eng: I've pushed a small patch to the tokenizer heuristic to cap pathological delimiter expansion, but that's for next deploy. For now: enable KV caching sticky route: `rwctl tenant-config set helix kv_cache_mode=sticky`
maria-oncall: After routing flip, p95 dropped to ~520ms, p99 to 1.9s within 90s. Errors down from +12% to +4%. Progressing.
product-anya: Noting product impact: Helix's webhooks are low-latency sensitive — keep them on short-seq variant temporarily and follow up with engineering patch.
mike-oncall: I'm taking the handoff from Maria for the next 2 hours. Summary: routing -> short-seq variant applied; pool scaled; KV sticky enabled. Current status: degraded but improving.
mike-oncall: Action items on my plate: 1) keep monitoring p99 for 30m 2) coordinate dev rollout for tokenizer patch 3) schedule tomorrow 10am RFC with eng-runtime + helix infra.
kevin-eng: Adding logs of a repro prompt (redacted customer data) that triggered the worst latencies: 3 large fenced code blocks separated by repeated `-----BEGIN DATA-----` lines. Suggest we add a tokenizer guard for repeated delimiter runs > 4.
sre-alex: Noted. Also adding a temporary rate-limit burst cap for Helix to smooth concurrency: `ratelimitctl --tenant helix --burst=50 --rate=20/s` (was 500 burst previously).
maria-oncall: Will that affect throughput? Helix may see increased client-side retries but will reduce server-side kv thrash. Informing helix-support-bot before enforced change.
helix-support-bot: Acknowledged, will inform Helix infra. They prefer rate-limit over model change but accept short-seq for now.
mike-oncall: Observability note: capture additional traces on the affected nodes and add the Helix prompt set to the regression test suite. I'll open a ticket.
kevin-eng: Created ticket INF-7331: "Tokenizer delimiter storm guard + add Helix promptset to regression" and assigned to eng-ml.
maria-oncall: Also recommending a runtime tweak: short-circuit tokenization for giant monolithic fences > 10k chars and treat as blob -> reduces per-token overhead. Put as follow-up.
product-anya: Please capture customer-facing summary and timeline for Helix support. I'll draft an email postmortem once incident is stable.
kevin-eng: For next deploy, we should include a canary that includes the tokenizer guard behind a flag and a perf test simulating Helix-like prompts at scale.
sre-alex: Monitoring: p95 now steady ~480ms, p99 ~1.6s. Error-rate at baseline. I'll slowly scale replicas back to normal in 30m if metrics stable.
mike-oncall: Handoff complete. If anything regresses, page me directly. Tagging follow-ups: INF-7331 (eng-ml), OPS-210 (rate-limit audit), DOCS-98 (customer communication).
incident-bot: Incident SEV2 -> downgraded to SEV3 at 4832110400 after mitigations. Recording timeline.
maria-oncall: Thanks team. I'll stay on channel for another 15m to confirm.
kevin-eng: FYI putting a short log snippet in the ticket for the pattern matcher.
mike-oncall: Closing active mitigation. We'll do a 1h post-incident sync and include Helix in the regression harness.
